# teams_external_access_configuration (Resource)

Manages the ExternalAccessConfiguration configuration via Set-CsTeamsExternalAccessConfiguration.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `identity` (String) Identity of the existing object whose configuration is managed.

### Optional

- `block_external_user_access` (Boolean) Maps to the -BlockExternalUserAccess parameter.
- `blocked_users` (String) Maps to the -BlockedUsers parameter.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Object identifier (GUID).
